ignore.reason: The rules run inside PHPStan, whose package ships the parser; requiring it would install a second copy. It stays in require-dev for bin/generate-sensitive-parameters.
The Doctrine mapping and PHPUnit rules match those classes in the analysed code and name them only through ::class, which never autoloads them.
The Webmozart rules match the class in the analysed code and name it only through ::class, which never autoloads it.
The code the rule tests analyse, never run: it names vendors and classes that do not exist, miscases names on purpose, and uses extensions and packages only to give the rules something to report.
The plugin runs inside Composer, which provides those classes itself; composer-plugin-api is the requirement, and composer/composer serves the analysis and the tests.
Composer provides symfony/console to a plugin at run time, as it provides its own classes; requiring it would install a copy beside the one Composer runs.

exclude.reason: The rule fixtures hold the code the rules report; they are not code to style.

excludePaths.reason: The rule fixtures hold the code the rules report; they are not code to analyse.

ignoreFiles.reason: The rule fixtures hold the code the rules report; they are not code to analyse.

skip.reason: The rule fixtures hold the code the rules report; they are not code to rewrite.
The generated lookup keys are lowercased Class::method strings, not class references.
